en: n. a liquid soap used for washing the hair; an act of washing the hair; v. to wash hair with shampoo; to clean a carpet using a special liquid
ex: She bought a new shampoo that smells like apples.
她買了一瓶有蘋果香味的新洗髮精。

en: a. that cannot be found; not in the usual place; absent or lacking; (of a person) gone without anyone knowing where
ex: The police are looking for the missing child.
警方正在尋找失蹤的孩子。

en: to stop something from happening; to stop someone from doing something; to make it impossible for something to happen
ex: Wearing a seat belt can prevent serious injuries.
繫安全帶可以預防嚴重傷害。

en: n. a large amount of something; a situation in which there is more than enough; a. (informal) more than enough; adv. (informal) fully
ex: We have plenty of time before the train leaves.
離火車開出還有很多時間。

en: n. a person who owns or keeps something; a device for holding something; a person who has a particular position or title
ex: The passport holder must show it at the gate.
護照持有人必須在登機口出示。

en: a. smooth and bright and reflecting light; polished and clean; (of cloth) worn smooth and bright from use
ex: The car was clean and shiny after the wash.
車子洗完後又乾淨又閃亮。

en: n. a flat round plate for storing computer data or music; a round flat object; (anatomy) a flat round piece between the bones of the spine
ex: Save the file onto a disk before you leave.
離開前請把檔案存到磁碟上。

en: n. an informal word for things, material or belongings; the substance that something is made of; (informal) rubbish; v. to fill something tightly with something; to push something quickly into a space; to eat too much
ex: Please put all your stuff in the bag before we leave.
離開前請把你所有的東西放進袋子裡。

en: n. one of the two organs in the body that remove waste from the blood and produce urine; the kidney of an animal, used as food; (old) a person's character or type
ex: He needs a kidney transplant to survive.
他需要腎臟移植才能活下去。

en: n. the quality of being extremely good; something that is very good in a particular way; high standard in something
ex: The school is well known for academic excellence.
這所學校以學術卓越聞名。

en: a small sweet orange fruit with a loose skin that is easy to peel; a deep orange color
ex: She peeled a tangerine and shared it with her friends.
她剝了一顆橘子和朋友分食。

en: n. a building for keeping a car in, often attached to a house; a place where cars are repaired or petrol is sold; v. to put a car in a garage
ex: He parked the car in the garage after work.
他下班後把車停進車庫。

en: n. a chance to do something or an occasion when it is possible to do something; a favorable time or situation
ex: This job is a great opportunity for a young engineer.
這份工作對年輕工程師來說是個很好的機會。

en: n. a place or state of perfect happiness; (in some religions) a place where good people go after they die; a very beautiful place
ex: The island is a paradise for divers.
這座島是潛水愛好者的天堂。

en: a piece of furniture with shelves for keeping books
ex: She put the dictionary back on the bookcase.
她把字典放回書架上。

en: a. complete or full; not divided or broken; n. the full amount of something; a complete thing made up of parts
ex: She ate the whole cake by herself.
她自己把整個蛋糕吃光了。

en: n. a person whose job is to manage the cleaning and cooking in a large house or hotel; a woman who looks after the home
ex: The housekeeper cleans the house every morning.
女管家每天早上打掃房子。

en: n. a large amount of money, property or valuable things; the condition of being rich; a large amount of something good
ex: His wealth comes from running several successful companies.
他的財富來自經營幾家成功的公司。

en: n. a group of people chosen to make decisions or do a particular job for a larger group
ex: The committee will meet next Monday to discuss the proposal.
委員會下週一將開會討論這項提案。

en: n. (informal) a close friend; v. (informal) to become friends with someone
ex: He went fishing with his old pal last weekend.
他上週末和老朋友去釣魚。

en: a hotel for people who are traveling by car, with parking space close to the rooms
ex: We stayed at a cheap motel on the way to the beach.
我們去海邊的路上住在一間便宜的汽車旅館。

en: a. on the outside of something; further from the center or inside; (of space) further away from Earth
ex: The outer walls of the building were painted white.
建築物的外牆漆成白色。

en: v. to repeat the exact words of a writer or speaker; to give a price for a job; to mention something as an example; n. a phrase taken from a book or speech; a price given for a job
ex: She quoted a line from Shakespeare in her speech.
她在演講中引用了一句莎士比亞的話。

en: n. a vegetable with large green leaves, usually eaten raw in salads; (informal) money
ex: I'd like a sandwich with lettuce and tomato.
我想要一個加萵苣和番茄的三明治。

en: n. a large bag made of strong material for carrying or storing things; (informal) dismissal from a job; the act of destroying a place and stealing from it; v. to put into a sack; to dismiss someone from a job; to rob and destroy a city
ex: He carried a sack of potatoes on his back.
他背著一袋馬鈴薯。

en: n. a device with two rows of metal or plastic teeth that fit together to close a piece of clothing or a bag; (BrE: zip)
ex: The zipper on my jacket is stuck.
我外套的拉鍊卡住了。

en: n. a tool with a heavy metal head used for hitting nails or breaking things; v. to hit something repeatedly with a hammer; to knock in nails; to defeat someone heavily
ex: He used a hammer to drive the nail into the wall.
他用鐵槌把釘子釘進牆裡。

en: v. to give a loud, high cry because you are frightened, excited or in pain; to shout something in a loud, high voice; n. a loud high cry; (informal) something very funny
ex: The children screamed with joy when they saw the snow.
孩子們看到雪時開心得尖叫起來。

en: to make someone unable to think clearly or understand something; to mistake one thing for another
ex: The instructions were so complicated that they confused me.
說明書太複雜了，讓我一頭霧水。
ph: 把 A 誤認為 B

en: n. a man of high rank in a noble family; (the Lord) God or Jesus Christ; a ruler or master; v. to behave in a bossy way toward people; to give someone a title
ex: The lord of the manor owned all the land around the village.
莊園領主擁有村子四周所有的土地。

en: v. to clean or dry something by rubbing it with a cloth; to remove something by rubbing; (informal) to destroy completely; n. an act of wiping; a small cloth for wiping
ex: Please wipe the table after dinner.
晚餐後請把桌子擦乾淨。

en: n. a duty to deal with or take care of something; the fact of being to blame for something; a thing that you must do as part of your job or role
ex: It is your responsibility to lock the door when you leave.
離開時鎖門是你的責任。

en: n. a musical instrument in the form of a thin pipe that you play by blowing across a hole; a tall thin glass for drinking champagne; a decorative groove; v. to play the flute; to cut grooves in something
ex: She plays the flute in the school orchestra.
她在學校樂團裡吹長笛。

en: to make something tighter; to become tighter or stricter; to make rules or controls stricter
ex: The government decided to tighten security at the airport.
政府決定加強機場的安全管制。

en: v. to shout loudly, often because you are angry, excited or in pain; n. a loud shout; a special call used by a team to show support
ex: Don't yell at me; I can hear you.
別對我大吼，我聽得到。

en: n. a figure of a person or animal made from stone, metal or clay, usually in a public place; v. to decorate with statues
ex: A bronze statue stands in the center of the square.
廣場中央矗立著一座青銅雕像。

en: a. at a high level of development; far on in a course of study; modern and recently developed; (of age) very old
ex: She is taking an advanced English course.
她正在上進階英文課程。

en: n. a light gentle wind; (informal) something that is very easy to do; v. to move quickly and in a relaxed or confident way; to do something without effort
ex: A cool breeze came in through the window.
一陣涼爽的微風從窗戶吹進來。

en: to travel through a place in order to learn about it; to examine something carefully in order to find out more about it; to think about something carefully
ex: We plan to explore the mountains next summer.
我們計畫明年夏天探險山區。

en: n. an African wild animal like a horse with black and white stripes; (zebra crossing) a place where people can cross the road
ex: The zebra stood among the other animals at the water hole.
斑馬站在水坑邊的其他動物之間。
